enchantments.tooltip: Overwhelming Despair: The moon empowers your Necromancy spells - causing them to bring Terror to your enemies. Your offensive Necromancy spells automatically apply Crushing Despair with no save.
Enchanting Death 3: Increases your caster level when casting enchantment and necromancy spells by 3.
Spell Penetration +8: Passive: +8 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Insightful Spell Penetration +4: Passive: +4 Insight bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
